Summarize in two sentences: A confidential virtual machine keeps its memory encrypted with a key held by the processor, so the host operating system and the hypervisor cannot read it. Before a service inside it is given secrets, a remote party checks a signed report from the processor that names the exact software that was loaded. Only if that software is the expected build are the secrets released, and every release is recorded so that it can be audited later.
